# CANDIDATE: VOLUME_PROFILE_POC_MAGNET_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Price exhibits mean-reversion toward the session's Point of Control (POC) from volume profile, acting as a magnetic support/resistance level. This edge exists because the POC represents the price level where the most volume traded during the session, indicating a fair value area to which price tends to revert, especially in moderate volatility regimes (VIX 15-30).

## Mechanism

Entry rule: Price crosses above the session POC (calculated from session open to current bar) on a bullish close (close in upper 50% of bar's range) with volume above 20-period average, 5EMA > 8EMA (ribbon bullish), price above VWAP, and not more than 0.3% above POC at bar open to avoid chasing; time between 9:45 and 15:30 EST. Exit shape: chart-stop at the low of the entry bar, TP1 at 1R, runner trail 10% off HWM.
